        return str(value)

            return PAM_SYSTEM_ERR

        env_list = self.pam_getenvlist(self.handle)

        env_count = 0
        pam_env_items = {}

        while True:
            try:

                env_item = env_item.decode(encoding)

                # Incorrectly formatted envlist item
                pass
            else:
                pam_env_items[pam_key] = pam_value

            env_count += 1

        return pam_env_items
